test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
What number will be present in place of the question mark?:

5, 24, 61, 122, 213, ?
solution:
The logic follows here is -

23 - 3 = 8 - 3 = 5

3³ - 3 = 27 - 3 = 24

4³ - 3 = 64 - 3 = 61

5³ - 3 = 125 - 3 = 122

6³ - 3 = 216 - 3 = 213

Similarly,

7³ - 3 = 343 - 3 = 340.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
